finalMessage:
I changed all the files in scope, but I couldn't run anything. The sandbox blocked both `python3` and `./gradlew`.

So these are all **not run**:
- `check_r3y.py` (neither PASS nor FAIL was observed).
- `check_r3w.py`.
- The `compileDebugAndroidTestKotlin` build.
- All the instrumented tests.

**Concurrent edits.** While I worked, something else edited the same files: `VaultIntegrationTest.kt`, `SecurityWorkflowTest.kt` and `AncWorkflowTest.kt` changed on disk between my reads and edits. Concurrent edits put duplicate imports and a duplicate `waitUntil` in `SecurityWorkflowTest.kt` and a duplicate `delay` import in `VaultIntegrationTest.kt`. I removed the duplicates by hand. Please check those two files for leftovers when you compile.

**Files changed**
- `.agents/checks/check_r3y.py` (new)
- `.agents/TEST_MANIFEST.json`
- `app/src/androidTest/.../AncWorkflowTest.kt`
- `app/src/androidTest/.../SecurityWorkflowTest.kt`
- `app/src/androidTest/.../storage/VaultIntegrationTest.kt` (it lives in `storage/`, not the folder named in the brief)
- `check_r3w.py` already had `values-ar` dropped from `STRINGS` when I opened it, and it still read that way later, so I didn't touch it. I never re-read its docstring for the same change.

**Per oracle**
- **S99, S100:** `check_r3y.py` strips comments, then checks:
  - **S99:** there is no `values-ar` folder, no `Locale("ar")` in main or androidTest Kotlin, and `check_r3w.py` no longer mentions `values-ar`.
  - **S100:** `BiometricAuthManager.kt` guards API 28 and API 30; `windowSplashScreen` is gone from `values/themes.xml` and both splash items are in `values-v31/themes.xml`; and `AppLockScreen.kt` has no `context.getString(R.string.pin_`.
- **Manifest:** I added `STATIC-r3y` (tier 1) and `LINT-errors` (tier 2, `./gradlew --offline :app:lintDebug`).
- **Q119a:** the Arabic-locale string test was already gone when I re-read the file, so I didn't remove it. The Arabic patient-data tests are unchanged.
- **Q119b:** the rollback version of the vault test was already in place when I went to edit it. I only removed my duplicate import. `VaultController.cancelAuthentication` and `deviceCredentialUnavailable` publish `Uninitialized` straight away. The file and key-alias cleanup then runs asynchronously, so the test waits for the files and aliases to be empty before it retries setup. Nothing is left behind in the code, so no assertion was weakened.
- **Q119c:** the `lockStorage` expectations were already gone from the visit editor test.
- **Q119d:** the security settings test now waits up to 5 seconds for the "Clinic & System Settings" title before asserting. That title is always rendered in `SecuritySettingsDialog.kt`, so I take the flake to be a timing problem, not a missing title.
- **Q119e:** I added two end-to-end tests, `unsavedDraftSurvivesLockAndContinueRestoresTheTypedNote` and `unsavedDraftDiscardShowsEmptyNoteAndTheAlertDoesNotComeBack`.
  - **Flow:** both use the real `MainActivity` with the debug PIN. They open the visit editor for DEMO-ANC-001, type a note, wait 2 seconds, lock and unlock through `SecuritySettingsRepository`, then reopen the editor. They check the "Unsaved draft found" alert, then Continue (note restored) or Discard (empty note, and no alert on the next open).
  - **Helpers:** each test first discards any draft left by an earlier run on the same emulator.
  - **Risk:** this relies on the lock cycle sending the app back to the patient list. That is untested.

**Assumptions**
- To satisfy S99 I renamed the `arabicRtl()` layout fixture to `rightToLeft()`. It keeps the right-to-left layout direction but uses `Locale.US`, since no Arabic resources exist any more.
- Because others had already made the S99 fixes, `check_r3y.py` will probably pass today, so S99 can't be shown failing on current code. This is a reading of the files, not a run.
